governing_instruments.title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS) Guidelines

decision_driving_rules.verbatim_quote: The applicant must be a citizen of India residing in Maharashtra.

decision_driving_rules.plain_en: Must be aged 60 years or above
decision_driving_rules.verbatim_quote: The age of the applicant must be 60 years or above.

decision_driving_rules.plain_en: Must belong to a household living Below Poverty Line (BPL)
decision_driving_rules.verbatim_quote: The applicant must belong to a household living Below Poverty Line (BPL) according to criteria prescribed by the Government.

exclusions.plain_en: Excludes households not identified as Below Poverty Line in official census
exclusions.verbatim_quote: The applicant must belong to a household living Below Poverty Line (BPL)
